text:
Ira (Sales): @Jordan asked for SIG/CAIQ evidence specifically around BCP/DR: RTO/RPO, backups, failover steps, recent test reports, and the SLA copy. They need something to hand to procurement by EOD Friday.

Camille (Security): We have a canned response set in the security wiki but it needs Ops numbers for Dedicated/Private. Link: /internal/security/sig-responses/bcp-dr (will sanitize for customer). Key callouts: multi-AZ failover, quarterly DR drills, backup cadence.

Mike (Solutions): Can Ops confirm official RTO/RPO by deployment (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)? Also we should prepare a concise table for procurement + one-page runbook excerpt. Jordan wants to know whether we can run a POC failover in staging.

Ash (Ops): Quick answers from infra: Hosted API SLA: 99.95% availability. Hosted RTO target for platform incidents: 2 hours (failover-assisted); Hosted RPO: 15–60 minutes depending on failure mode (we treat KV cache as ephemeral). Backups: customer metadata snapshots daily, 30d retention; encrypted at rest. For Dedicated: customers can configure cross-region replication (RPO down to 15m) and we commit to helping during failover windows. We run full failover drills quarterly. Attached artifact name: dr-test-2025-11-12.pdf.

Camille (Security): For SIG answers we should avoid absolute language where it depends on deployment config. Suggest wording: "RTO/RPO vary by deployment option; typical targets: Hosted RTO 2h / RPO 1h; Dedicated (configurable) RTO 1–2h / RPO as low as 15m with cross-region replication." Also need signed SOC2 references and the last DR drill evidence.

Ira (Sales): Jordan — will that table + runbook excerpt + the DR test PDF and SLA PDF be sufficient? Any other docs procurement expects? Also want to know if we can share logs or more detailed timelines (NDA?). :thinking_face:

Jordan (Customer): That sounds perfect. Procurement specifically listed: (1) deployment-specific RTO/RPO, (2) evidence of past DR tests, (3) SLA PDF, (4) backup/retention policy. We have an NDA in place so sanitized artifacts are fine. They might ask for a short call to walk through the runbook.

DeployBot: runbook v2.1 pushed by Ash at 1938274590 -> /ops/runbooks/bcp-v2.1 (internal).

Ash (Ops): I'll assemble a sanitized artifact bundle: runbook excerpt, DR test slides (dr-test-2025-11-12.pdf), SLA_2025-99-95.pdf, backup-policy-2025.pdf, and a short CSV mapping of RTO/RPO per deployment. ETA: drop in shared drive by 16:00 PT today.

Mike (Solutions): If they want an actual POC failover, propose window Fri 10:00–11:00 PT. We'll need Jordan to confirm expected traffic and a short rollback plan. I can schedule the ops runbook walkthrough.

Camille (Security): When Ash drops artifacts, I'll redact any internal-only runbook steps and add the SIG-friendly answers. Also will produce a one-paragraph control statement for "BCP/DR testing" that maps to SIG/CAIQ phrases.

Ira (Sales): Great. Action items: Ash assemble artifacts, Camille sanitize + SIG wording, Mike coordinate POC slot, Ira to confirm with procurement. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Ash (Ops): snippet of failover config I'll include in the bundle (sanitized):
```
failover_policy: 
  primary_region: us-west-2
  secondary_region: us-east-1
  detection_window_seconds: 60
  auto_failover: false  # manual approval required for customer-impacting failover
  expected_rto_minutes: 120
  expected_rpo_minutes: 60
```

Jordan (Customer): Perfect — we'll review and loop back with a preferred POC time. Thanks everyone.
